Lemma
1. ch4:4.10,ch4:4.23\group ch04-poisson-newtonian-potential Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0076 If $f\in C^\alpha (\overline B_2^+)$ and $w$ is its Newtonian potential on $B_2^+$, then $w\in C^{2,\alpha }(\overline B_1^+)$ and \begin{equation} \tag {4.23} |D^2w|'_{0,\alpha ;B_1^+}\leq C|f|'_{0,\alpha ;B_2^+}, \qquad C=C(n,\alpha ). \end{equation}
Proof

\sketch Apply the proof of Lemma 8 to $B_2^+$. Boundary terms on $T$ vanish for tangential second derivatives; recover $D_{nn}w$ from $\Delta w=f$.

□
